Contract ManageSubjectCRUDService::createSubject(name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		subject: Subject = manageSubject.Subject->any(s|s.Name = name)
	precondition:
		manageSubject.Subject->excludes(subject)
	postcondition:
		let newSubject: Subject in
		newSubject.oclIsNew() and
		newSubject.Name = name and
		manageSubject.Subject->includes(newSubject) and
		result = true
}
